ios.desc:
"Don't Fly Without This App" WSJ • Finalist for App of The Year • Winner of Apple Design Award

The flight tracker your pilot uses.

Free trial does not required credit card.
No account required.
No newsletters.
No ads.

▶ WORLD'S FASTEST DELAY ALERTS
- 2-90 minutes faster than airline apps
- 24-48 hours faster cancellation alerts
- Always be the first to know, with no effort

▶ INDUSTRY-FIRST FEATURES
- See WHY you're flight is delayed
- 25-hour where's my plane
- Flighty Friends – private sharing among family/friends
- Pilot-Grade data – FAA and Eurocontrol
- Delay Predictions
- Gate Predictions
- Flighty Passport – auto-create your personal flight map
- Airport Intelligence – plain word summary of the status
- Taxi times
- Ground radar
- Proximity radar

▶ AUTOMATIONS
- Calendar sync
- TripIt sync
- Email forwarding
- Flighty Friends: private flight sharing with friends

▶ PILOT-GRADE DATA
- Live-streaming
- Actual flight plans
- Commercial data – same source used by your pilot
- FAA advisories, warnings, and delays
- Tail number – with birthday, type, and even name
- Full flight timetable
- Proximity radar - see flights around you
- Ground radar - radar even while taxiing

▶ BE THE FIRST TO KNOW
- Late arriving aircraft delays – up to 6 hours before your airline!
- Alerts for canceled inbound aircraft
- Alerts for airport weather or traffic
- Delay forecast

▶ ASSISTANTS
- Morning-Of Assistant - wake up informed
- Check In Assistant - your reservation number and check in link at the right time
- Connection Assistant - see all the checkpoints required for your connection and how long it typically takes
- Import Assistant - seamless import (plus data enrichment!) from myFlightradar24, App In The Air, OpenFlights.org, FlightMemory, Logmyflight, and JetLovers

▶ WORLDWIDE + LIVE + UNLIMITED
- Every airline
- Every flight
- 24/7/365 live global coverage

▶ FLIGHTY FRIENDS
- Often sharing with Family and Friends? Invite them to see your flights and never manually share again!
- Picking someone up, excited for a friend to visit, meeting a colleague? Share your live flight status with one tap.

▶ WHAT'S FREE?
- No ads
- Unlimited flights
- Flighty Friends
- Live data
- Weather
- Actual flight route
- Aircraft model and image
- Personal flight log and map
- Personal all-time and annual stats
- Apple Watch app
- iCloud backup & sync
- Historical flight input and import limited to past 365 days (due to costs)
- Lock screen widgets (limited refresh for costs)
- Ai

quotes.text:
> There's this iOS app called Flightly

I guess it's Flighty (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/flighty-live-flight-tracker/id1358823008?platform=iphone)

I love that people are into this. In the days before iPhones, I had "Microsoft Streets and Trips" + a USB GPS unit + Laptop. It was fun having it on a flight and seeing movement data in realtime. It was less fun answering questions from people who thought looking at the GPS data was somehow nefarious.

quotes.text:
I'll start with two recent standouts:

Flighty: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/flighty-live-flight-tracker/id1358823008

As someone who travels every couple of months for work, this app has quickly jumped to the top of my list when I'm thinking of apps that solve a problem without compromise. Great UX, timely and truly helpful notification content, and a satisfying design that takes advantage of all the cool features iOS has to offer.

Artifact: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/artifact-intelligent-news/id1572927568

Google News has a good recommendation algorithm, but an uninspired design and very limited feature set. Apple News has a great design, but finding interesting content is a challenge even after months of trying to actively curate its algorithm. Artifact doesn't have the best recommendation engine, but it's pretty good and much more transparent/configurable than its competition, and its clever usage of GPT to dynamically combat clickbait headlines and summarize articles works surprisingly well.
